next.reason: 1985: the END PROGRAM program-name 'must conform to the rules for forming a user-defined word'. 2023 format §2023:10.7.2 takes program-name-1, which §2023:10.7.3 SR2 makes 'identical to the program-name declared in a preceding PROGRAM-ID paragraph'; program-name is listed among the user-defined words of §2023:8.3.2.2, whose formation rules include §2023:8.3.2.1 SR1 (no reserved words) and §2023:8.3.2.2 SR3 (at least one letter). Formation details (63 characters, underscore) belong to the 1985 word-formation rule, not this one. Same requirement. Catalog note: the 8.3.2.1 general paragraph and the 8.3.2.2 type list carry no catalog id.
